remarks: Classic charm meets modern living in this updated colonial, set on over an acre with a stunning wood roof, stone walls, and a circular driveway. Entirely new second floor added. Now you have 4+ bedrooms, 4 full baths, and flexible living spaces on both floors. The main level features a spacious living room, den/office, guest suite/office, large playroom, eat-in kitchen, family room with the kitchen, bar room, and formal dining room. Upstairs, the primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, dual walk-in closets, and a marble double shower. You'll find a bedroom/nursery off of the primary suite plus an easy way to make a third bedroom. There is ample yard space to add a pool or party barn. Just minutes from local golf and tennis clubs and easy access to the Allwood neighborhood. Curb appeal, privacy, and possibility - this is the one.
